distribution.summary: 黑龙江；四川；云南；西藏；香港
distribution.narrative: Mainland China is confirmed by 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) (Heilongjiang, Sichuan, Yunnan and Xizang). Beaver & Liu (2010) separately treated the historical Taiwan attribution as doubtful because the record was based on Shiraki specimens of uncertain origin. Taiwan is therefore retained as Questionable and is not added to the current distribution summary. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Current hosts are synthesized from 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015). Beaver & Liu (2010) provides no host evidence for the doubtful Taiwan record, so it does not alter the current host synthesis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Crypturgus pusillus (Gyllenhal, 1813).
